paragraphs.text: Grusilda , Monster Masher , is a legendary Zombie Villain from Bablovia .

Grusilda is a member of the League of Dastardly Doom on Bablovia . She is part of the Legion of Evil, the ruling cabal that currently controls the League. She appears as a female humanoid zombie with a partially detached jaw and long purple hair and wields a large mechanical claw.
